title: Putin Expresses Understanding of Trump's Ukraine De-escalation Proposals
detail: The Kremlin said Putin expressed understanding of Trump's proposals to de-escalate the Ukraine war during their latest contact, marking a shift from prior messaging that peace talks were unlikely. The statement signals a potential opening in diplomatic communications between Moscow and Washington.

title: Kremlin: Putin Relayed Iran's Position on Ending Hostilities to Trump
detail: The Kremlin confirmed that Putin relayed Iran's position on ending hostilities to Trump during their call, underscoring Russia's role as intermediary between Tehran and Washington. The development highlights Moscow's continued diplomatic outreach bridging multiple regional conflicts.

title: Ukraine Peace Talks Stumble as Trump-Putin Diesel Deal Fractures Western Coalition Pressure
detail: The New York Times reports that Ukraine peace negotiations have stalled following a US-Russia diesel fuel supply agreement reached between Trump and Putin. The deal is reportedly fracturing Western coalition pressure on Moscow, as allies grow concerned that bilateral energy arrangements are undercutting unified sanctions and diplomatic leverage.

title: Putin Personally Informs Trump of Russia's Oil Supply Commitment to US and Global Markets
detail: The Kremlin confirmed that President Vladimir Putin personally informed former US President Donald Trump that Russia would supply oil to the United States and global markets, formalizing an energy deal. The announcement signals a significant shift in Russia-US energy relations amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.
